title: D-SP-4 Stage 2d: MCP cancellation for in-flight mission_run
goal: Map MCP notifications/cancelled (and task cancellation) for an in-flight mission_run tool call to a cooperative cancel flag carried across plane-bus hops. SusiMasterAgent checks the flag at phase boundaries, stops early, and records status CANCELLED (exit_code 1). Synchronous tools other than mission_run keep their existing behaviour.
